items.text: Your AI Slop Bores Me lets players role-play a human chatbot, answering other users’ questions while parodying formulaic AI responses.
items.text_zh: “Your AI Slop Bores Me”让玩家扮演真人聊天机器人，回答其他用户的问题，以此戏仿套路化的 AI 回复。

items.text: Cloudflare Computer gives AI agents persistent, isolated environments that can retain files and processes while running long-lived tasks.
items.text_zh: Cloudflare Computer 为 AI 智能体提供可持久保存文件和进程的隔离环境，用于执行长时间任务。

items.text: A woman alleged that her stepfather used Grok to turn her childhood photograph into explicit imagery, highlighting generative-image abuse risks.
items.text_zh: 一名女子称继父使用 Grok 将她的童年照片改成露骨图像，再次凸显生成式图像的滥用风险。

items.text: Google AI Studio invited developers to share weekend vibe-coding projects, reflecting continued community promotion of prompt-driven application building.
items.text_zh: Google AI Studio 邀请开发者分享周末“氛围编程”项目，继续推动以提示词驱动的应用开发方式。

items.text: GitHub demonstrated creating a custom-domain Pages site with HTTPS in roughly 14 minutes without manually editing DNS records.
items.text_zh: GitHub 演示了如何在约 14 分钟内创建使用自定义域名和 HTTPS 的 Pages 网站，全程无需手动修改 DNS 记录。

items.text: An essay argued that AI systems possess vastly more working memory than humans, helping explain their advantage on some mathematical tasks.
items.text_zh: 一篇文章认为，AI 系统拥有远超人类的工作记忆容量，这有助于解释其在部分数学任务上的优势。

items.text: GitHub spotlighted debate over whether open-source agent platform OpenClaw could become an AI-era equivalent of Linux.
items.text_zh: GitHub 聚焦了一场讨论：开源智能体平台 OpenClaw 是否可能成为 AI 时代的 Linux。

items.text: A Google Developer Expert built a vision agent that transforms live webcam selfies into generative artwork.
items.text_zh: 一位 Google 开发者专家构建了视觉智能体，可将摄像头中的实时自拍转换为生成式艺术作品。

items.text: Astro’s creator introduced Flue, a React-inspired meta-harness using hooks to compose and manage AI-agent behavior.
items.text_zh: Astro 创始人推出 Flue：一种借鉴 React、通过 Hooks 组合和管理 AI 智能体行为的元框架。

items.text: Databricks shared DevHub prompts that help coding agents inspect environments and set up Databricks Apps from natural-language instructions.
items.text_zh: Databricks 分享了 DevHub 提示词，帮助编程智能体检查环境，并通过自然语言指令配置 Databricks Apps。

items.text: The Decoder reported investor pressure was pushing Nvidia to reduce its planned OpenAI investment as Anthropic’s financial performance strengthened.
items.text_zh: The Decoder 报道称，在 Anthropic 财务表现走强之际，投资者压力正促使英伟达缩减原计划对 OpenAI 的投资。

items.text: PixVerse highlighted a user-made AI video whose emotional performance was presented as an intentional directing choice rather than incidental model output.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示了一段用户制作的 AI 视频，并称其中的情绪表现源于有意的导演选择，而非模型的偶然输出。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a practical guide to fine-tuning tool-calling language models using XYZ-Aquila-SFT and Qwen3.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布实用指南，介绍如何使用 XYZ-Aquila-SFT 与 Qwen3 微调具备工具调用能力的语言模型。

items.text: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon’s marketplace, increasing discoverability problems and depressing sales for some human authors, The Decoder reported.
items.text_zh: The Decoder 报道称，AI 生成书籍大量涌入亚马逊，令作品更难被发现，并压低部分人类作者的销量。

items.text: Actress Joey Wong publicly confirmed authorizing her AI likeness for NetEase’s short film Qian Ying, saying people should use AI rather than be used by it.
items.text_zh: 演员王祖贤首次公开确认授权网易短片《倩影》使用其 AI 形象，并表示人应当驾驭 AI，而非被 AI 驾驭。

items.text: China’s first AI home-robot flagship store opened in Qingdao, offering demonstrations of household robots and wearable exoskeletons.
items.text_zh: 全国首家 AI 家庭机器人旗舰店在青岛开业，消费者可现场体验家用机器人和可穿戴外骨骼。

items.text: A financial-technology case study described extending AI coding from code generation across the full software-development lifecycle.
items.text_zh: 一项金融科技实践展示了如何将 AI 编程从单纯生成代码扩展至完整的软件开发生命周期。

items.text: OpenAI reportedly dissolved a team dedicated to catastrophic AI risks and reassigned its responsibilities and remaining personnel across other groups.
items.text_zh: 据报道，OpenAI 解散了专门研究灾难性 AI 风险的团队，并将其职责及剩余人员分散至其他团队。

items.text: MCP’s proposed shift toward stateless requests sparked developer debate over whether the agent-connection standard was converging back toward conventional APIs.
items.text_zh: MCP 拟转向无状态请求，引发开发者争论：这一智能体连接标准是否正在重新趋近传统 API。

items.text: The Little Learner project explored how a language model behaves when its training material never exceeds fifth-grade reading level.
items.text_zh: Little Learner 项目研究了当训练材料始终不超过小学五年级阅读水平时，语言模型会呈现怎样的能力。

items.text: Alibaba highlighted Atomic Chat running the 27-billion-parameter Qwen3.8 model locally on a laptop for everyday work.
items.text_zh: 阿里巴巴展示了 Atomic Chat 在笔记本电脑本地运行 270 亿参数 Qwen3.8 模型，用于日常工作。

items.text: Anthropic’s biological-weapons safety filter was reportedly inactive for nearly a year, leaving approximately 133 million requests without that safeguard.
items.text_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 的生物武器安全过滤器停用近一年，约 1.33 亿次请求未受到该防护机制检查。

items.text: Optima introduced customizable AI evaluations that let organizations benchmark models against their own tasks and data instead of relying solely on standardized tests.
items.text_zh: Optima 推出可定制 AI 评测，让机构使用自身任务和数据比较模型，而不再只依赖标准化测试。

items.text: WorkSwarm presented an office-agent system designed to coordinate multiple specialized AI workers as a collaborative team rather than a single assistant.
items.text_zh: WorkSwarm 展示了一套办公智能体系统，将多个专业 AI 协调成协作团队，而非只提供单一助手。

items.text: A survey found one in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI that they previously would have assigned to colleagues.
items.text_zh: 一项调查发现，五分之一的美国劳动者如今会把原本交给同事的任务转交给 AI。

items.text: Dreamina opened the final ten-day stretch of its AI music-video contest, requiring entrants to combine an original track with AI-generated visuals.
items.text_zh: Dreamina 的 AI 音乐视频大赛进入最后十天，参赛者需把原创音乐与 AI 生成视觉内容结合。

items.text: Together AI said Yutori’s screenshot-driven Navigator browser agent surpassed frontier-model performance on its tests through rapid perception-action loops.
items.text_zh: Together AI 表示，Yutori 的 Navigator 浏览器智能体凭借快速的截图—操作循环，在其测试中超过了前沿模型。

items.text: A Huawei ADS-equipped Voyah sedan reportedly triggered automatic emergency braking after detecting an obstacle while driving through an inverted tunnel loop.
items.text_zh: 据报道，一辆搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 的岚图轿车驶过隧道大回环顶部时识别到障碍物并触发自动紧急制动。
